__inputs.name: DS_INFLUX
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB v2 datasource pointing at the bucket kvm-center writes to.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}host" and r._field == "cpu_usage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}host" and r._field == "mem_usage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}vm" and r._field == "state_code" and r._value == 1)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}host" and r._field == "vm_count" and r.status == "online")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}vm" and r._field == "cpu_usage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)
  |> top(n: 10, columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${prefix}vm" and r._field == "state_code")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["state"])
  |> count()
